如果奔跑是我的人生
programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampampampltbrampampampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 西拉沐淪河發源於內蒙古高原的渾善達克沙地腹地，在赤峰境內奔流407千米後，匯入西遼河，最終注入渤海，是中國北方重要的河流之一西拉沐淪河流域作為內蒙古東部重要的水源涵養地，維持著周邊草原沙地濕地的生態平衡同時，流域內棲息著多種候鳥（如丹頂鶴白枕鶴）魚類（如瓦氏雅羅魚）及珍稀植物，是東亞澳大利西亞候鳥遷徙通道的重要組成部分，蜿蜒流淌的高原長河，孕育著豐富的野生動物種群和多樣的植被類型，使西拉沐淪河流域成為了中國北方的生物基因庫由中央廣播電視總台推出的西拉沐淪是中國首部北疆河流生態科學紀錄片全片共 4集，每集25分鐘深入內蒙古高原渾善達克沙地腹地，透過地質動物植物與環境依存關係，全方位展現西拉沐淪河流域（赤峰一帶）的壯麗自然景觀與豐富物種本節目由ampampamplt赤峰市融媒體中心ampampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 夕陽無限好，安享晚年是無數老人家心願，但未必人人如願，部份長者，有些難關特別難面對紀錄片邊緣老人帶大家去到世界各地，審視長者面臨的問題，包括年老抑鬱老人騙局缺乏資源養老等

programme.title: 西拉沐淪
programme.desc: 西拉沐淪河發源於內蒙古高原的渾善達克沙地腹地，在赤峰境內奔流407千米後，匯入西遼河，最終注入渤海，是中國北方重要的河流之一西拉沐淪河流域作為內蒙古東部重要的水源涵養地，維持著周邊草原沙地濕地的生態平衡同時，流域內棲息著多種候鳥（如丹頂鶴白枕鶴）魚類（如瓦氏雅羅魚）及珍稀植物，是東亞澳大利西亞候鳥遷徙通道的重要組成部分，蜿蜒流淌的高原長河，孕育著豐富的野生動物種群和多樣的植被類型，使西拉沐淪河流域成為了中國北方的生物基因庫由中央廣播電視總台推出的西拉沐淪是中國首部北疆河流生態科學紀錄片全片共 4集，每集25分鐘深入內蒙古高原渾善達克沙地腹地，透過地質動物植物與環境依存關係，全方位展現西拉沐淪河流域（赤峰一帶）的壯麗自然景觀與豐富物種本節目由ampampamplt赤峰市融媒體中心ampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 九部的檢察官
programme.desc: 故事講述未成年人檢察部的主任雷旭（張譯飾），與未檢檢察官都子瑜（秦嵐飾）書記員楊甜（徐帆飾）法警徐張荔（王真兒飾）及檢察官助理劉柳（鄒元清飾）在辦理未成年人案件的同時，深掘案件背後的真相，同心呵護少年以愛澆灌未來的故事秦嵐飾演的檢察官深耕少年事件多年，被看好升官，但是她的前男友雷旭卻突然空降成為未成年人檢察部主任，兩人極力隱藏曾經交往的事實，以上司跟下屬身分再度共事，一度針鋒相對的兩人也逐漸解開過往心結，攜手深掘未成年案件背後隱藏的真相

programme.title: 2026 FIFA世界盃：烏拉圭 對 西班牙
鯤鵬擊浪
programme.desc: 該劇由劉飚執導，劉承林米卓清領銜主演，講述1918年毛澤東從湖南第一師範畢業到1921年參加黨的一大所歷經的心路歷程這期間中國發生了巨大的變化，新文化運動掀起西學東漸的風潮，馬克思主義的曙光第一次照進中國，五四運動高舉起自由與民主的旗幟，軍閥混戰的硝煙加重了中國人民的苦難在這風雲際會的歷史舞台上，各方勢力風起雲湧，詭異的時局迷霧重重，國家和民族的命運如同蕭瑟寒風中的一葉扁舟，生死存亡只在一瞬這幾年間，毛澤東在國家民族危難之際，胸懷大志堅韌不拔尋找救國救民道路，從一個青年學子逐漸成長為堅定的馬克思主義者該劇通過毛澤東北上尋求真理組織青年學生赴法勤工儉學領導湖南驅張運動創辦湘江評論開展學運工運組建湖南共產主義小組等事件，記述了毛澤東如何在紛繁雜亂的眾多主義中尋找到馬克思主義並為之奮鬥一生的感人故事

programme.title: 사랑의 블랙홀

programme.title: 조폭 마누라

programme.title: 너의 이름은.
programme.desc: 도쿄 소년 타키와 시골 소녀 미츠하는 자꾸 몸이 뒤바뀐다. 이런 일이 반복되자 서로 규칙을 만들어 행동하던 어느 날, 미츠하가 타키의 휴대폰에 남겨놓았던 흔적들이 모두 사라져버린다. 이를 이상하게 여긴 타키는 기억을 되짚어서 그녀가 살던 마을로 향하지만, 그 마을은 3년 전 혜성 충돌로 인해 이미 사라져버린지 오래. 타키는 참사 당일의 미츠하와 다시 몸을 바꿔서 마을을 구조하는 계획을 세우게 되는데...

programme.title: 굿 윌 헌팅
programme.desc: 이 영화의 시나리오는 50페이지 분량에 불과한 단편소설에서 출발했고, 단편소설을 쓴 사람은 다름아닌 윌 헌팅의 배역으로 열연한 맷 데이먼.1998년 제70회 아카데미상 후보선정에 최우수 작품상, 남우주연상 등 9개 부문에 노미네이트되었고, 그해 골든글로브 상에서는 최우수 각본상을 수상했다.맷 데이먼과 벤 애플렉이 할리우드에 입성하게 된 계기가 된 영화.

programme.title: 스위치
programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD載成與石鎮是公司的前後輩，也是稱兄道弟的關係，石鎮與老婆是無性夫婦，所以很羨慕新婚每晚火熱的載成，然而載成與老婆在性方面也有摩擦，對自己胸部感到自卑的貞熙每次做愛時都不願脫掉內衣，為此喜愛胸部的石鎮非常不滿某日載成出差時，妻子秀珍來訪，石鎮的雙眼離不開秀珍那對有著又深又長事業線的豐胸，欲求不滿的秀珍要求載成吃下同學會拿到的，比藍色小藥丸更強十倍的壯陽藥，兩人久違地共度春宵載成與石鎮下班後一起喝酒，並到載成家續攤，貞熙因時間已晚為由勸石鎮留宿，因為宿醉到廚房喝水的石鎮，碰上了躲避載成打呼聲的貞熙，石鎮藉著醉意摸了一下貞熙的臀部，貞熙雖然生氣質問，卻也因著酒精催化，兩人不知不覺做了起來，熟睡的石鎮完全不知情，載成隔天也裝作沒事正常上班載成無法忘懷與貞熙共度的夜晚，以出差為藉口和貞熙上床，同時間，秀珍帶著解酒藥與換洗衣物來到辦公室，把誤以為是解酒湯的壯陽藥給了載成服

programme.title: 禁慾俘虜
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD由美與丈夫宏太來到第一次約會的酒吧時，遇上著名攝影師Kenny Kenny不但拍攝了由美的引人身段，更獲得了她的身體 雖然對Kenny來說,由美只不過是他在無數一夜情經驗的其中一人， 但由美的想法卻是除了丈夫以外， Kenny便是她唯一的男人！為得到Kenny，由美引誘Kenny到別墅中及將他禁錮，並在Kenny打算逃走時剪去他的腳趾以示懲戒！承受著身心的威脅，卻漸對由美產生同情此間Kenny開始享受由美的特別性侍候，亦甚至忘記自己是個被禁錮的人...

programme.title: 強姦終極篇-最後羔羊
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD小嫻（關秀媚）是一位頗負盛名的流行愛情小說家，有三個死黨，冰冰（楊梵），Laura（姚樂怡）和Natasia（苑瓊丹），幾位好朋友在經常在小嫻家聚會，一日，小嫻女友冰冰（楊梵）將車停泊在鄰居DANIEL（吳毅將）家門口，竟就此失蹤，其後被人發現棄屍海灘！富家子弟Daniel外表斯文俊朗兼有學識，但內心其實是變態色魔，不久前，他才幫助兩位好友逃獄，現在更變本加厲，追求更大的刺激小嫻的警察男朋友輝（張家輝）及夥伴寶文（朱茵）接手調查冰冰死亡的案件，在亳無線索之下，只好拜託以前香港第一色魔食人博士（黃秋生）協助破案博士對色魔的心態了如指掌，遂設計一局中局，使Daniel有機會將小嫻LauraNatasia脅持到他家準備施暴，而暗地裡，警方悄然包圍DANIEL家，欲一舉擒住Daniel，沒想到卻失敗了，小嫻陷入危機中

programme.title: 擋不住的瘋情
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD電腦公司經理孫志輝過著雙重人格的乖僻生活白日裡在公司勤勞做事，對女人與金錢嗤之以鼻；夜晚卻末尾百般設法接近自己的夢中情人 電視臺當紅掌管人黃潔怡孫志輝不只搬到黃所住公寓的對面用望遠鏡監視其的一舉一動，更用錄影機跟蹤拍攝，並用鐵棒經驗了所有對黃潔怡無禮或是希圖接近她的男人一次偶然的時機，孫志輝對於黃潔怡和她的有錢男友查理的恩愛妒火中燒，查理在黃潔怡身邊的頻頻出現讓孫志輝再也無法忍受，於是在二人訂婚的假面舞會上，孫志輝終於末尾採取舉動

programme.title: 很好吃的女大學生
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD在敏智家裡合宿的芷梧與書瑛芷梧與書瑛拖欠了好幾個月的住宿費，而敏智在催促著房租書瑛為了交出住宿費，開始了約會打工，芷梧也跟著書瑛做起了約會打工雖然住宿費都交了，敏智卻宣布禁止男人出入即使如此，人們仍偷偷往來宿舍，芷梧的愛人允晟被敏智逮到了，敏智威脅允晟且發生了性關係，事後敏智感謝地告訴芷梧與書瑛偶爾帶男人回來也可以書瑛為了交出住宿費，開始了約會打工，芷梧也跟著書瑛做起了約會打工雖然住宿費交了，敏智卻宣布禁止男人出入即使如此，男人們仍偷偷往來宿舍，芷梧的愛人允晟被敏智逮到了，敏智威脅允晟且發生了性關係，事後敏智感謝地告訴芷梧與書瑛偶爾帶男人回來也可以

programme.title: 米蘭達
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD米蘭達是威尼斯一家酒吧的老闆，丈夫在二戰中戰死而她周旋在不同的男性之間，卻無法找到真愛，直到來自美國的洛曼到來

programme.title: 玩物戀人
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD我是薇吉妮，一位年輕獨立的女性我的工作讓我十分忙碌：我是一名妓女，高檔的那種從我的立場來看，這是能發生在我身上最好的事了我知道怎麼贏得客人的尊敬，我的生活過得很好，直到我遇見了他他不是很討人喜歡，雖然有的是錢他感覺背負著一個沉重使命，是那種能為信念而死的人一場災難即將來臨，而他卻迎面直入其中，並且找上了我

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD湯姆尤厄爾送他的妻子和兒子到緬因州避暑後，最近幻想有外遇的他遇見一個22歲白膚金髮的電視模特兒，在他家樓上租了公寓，他邀請女孩下樓喝飲料他在美女鄰居的誘惑中和他幻想他的妻子來捉姦之間受盡折磨和考驗

programme.title: 週末同床
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD任職大學教授的俊榮一向崇尚有性無愛，朋友為答謝他當伴郎而替他安排約會，從而認識了性感開放的燈飾設計師娟姬兩人首次約會，互相言不在意地閒談，更喝得銘酊大醉也不知是誰提議到飯店開房比坐計程車便宜，雙方便發生了第一次關係 思想開放的娟姬毫不介意這個只求戀愛不求結婚的男人兩人開始孕育出一段微妙的關係：她為了物質上的需要而嫁給一個醫生，然後用他的錢資助俊榮，替他租了個房間，亦成了兩人的愛巢娟姬一到週末便來，兩人一起逛街看電視和做愛漸漸地，究竟他們是一對偷情的男女，還是一對幸福美滿的夫婦？

programme.title: 白肉豐臀
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD在二次大戰末期，德國納粹SS黨衛軍徵召了一群自願的貌美女子來為前線的德軍做特殊的服務，為了心中的夢想走上了戰場，這群女兵們在戰場上和戰場下的生活愛情和欲望相互交織在一起，但是事情卻變得複雜，還必須提防女軍官與同袍的誘惑，特別是對付蘇俄軍隊的戰況日趨激烈她們命運會如何呢?

programme.title: 斬霸王
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD朝鮮王朝的第9代君主成宗，白天的他是大王，但一到夜晚卻成了色魔從垂簾聽政的母親手中逐漸奪回政權的成宗，跟哥哥月山大君同時愛上了於於同原是大官女兒的於於同，嫁給了一個體弱的郎君夫君死後，政府以烈女門為由要求一夫終死，於於同改名換姓逃離家門成為賣花女，也因此認識了月山大君

programme.title: 好色正液聯盟
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD當巨大的邪惡威脅地球時，好色正液聯盟絕對會保衛地球蝙蝠俠與羅賓要如何與貓女合作，神力女超人與超人又會遇到怎樣的困境呢？

programme.title: 色即是空
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD恩植暗戀恩俞，在公車上在被誤會是色狼，被恩俞一踢在了要害部位，疼得他倒在車箱裡哇哇大叫一場誤會讓他們成為好友甚至有一次，他對著電腦的淫穢畫面手淫時，被恩俞撞見雖然恩俞跟學校的花心大帥哥交往，恩植依然對她很好甚至下海當牛郎賺錢，只為買下恩俞喜歡的戒指，當生日禮物送她直到恩俞不小心懷孕，恩植仍然陪著她去墮胎，並且在身旁細心的照顧她，最後她終於明白真正喜歡她的人是恩植 . . . . .

programme.title: 激情邊緣
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHDJOHN與安妮在結婚前夕準備結婚時，被不明車子撞到，JOHN不幸死亡， 而安妮流產，幾近崩潰出院後，偶遇徐文彬的妻子美秀及兒子仔仔，恰巧美秀需要請保母來照顧她的兒子而由於美秀有心臟病，不能太劇烈興奮作愛，一天美秀為了改良夫妻感情，居然利用安妮肉體，當做結婚紀念日的禮物，從此就種下了悲劇的危機而安妮有天意外發現徐文彬的車牌號碼，她決定帶他到墓園，請君入甕

programme.title: 致命計謀
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD世熙就讀高中的時候，爸爸最信任的左右手成俊在背後設計陷害，導致公司破產，爸爸也因此自殺身亡，並遺留下大筆債務年紀尚輕的世熙根本還不起這筆高利貸，成俊便順勢以此為藉口，佔有了世熙青春的肉體

programme.title: 金瓶雙艷
programme.desc: 極限 JstarHD西門慶是個性虐待狂，雖已有一妻三妾，仍到處獵豔看上武大郎的妻子潘金蓮後，西門慶在貪財的王婆的說明下設計令潘金蓮上鉤，後三人又合議出毒計殺死了武大郎被西門慶納為妾後，為保地位，潘金蓮開始不斷配合西門慶嘗試種種變態性行為遇上友人花子虛之妻李瓶兒後，西門慶色心再起，終用卑劣手段將李瓶兒和花子虛的錢財一石二鳥弄到了手多出強勁敵手李瓶兒後，不甘就此失勢的潘金蓮為奪西門慶更多歡心與她展開明爭暗鬥

programme.title: 新聞今日談
programme.desc: 新聞今日談: 節目針對當天最熱門時事問題, 在觀眾最關注的時刻即時作出評論, 讓觀眾更洞悉事件的真相

programme.title: 鳳凰聚焦 第1207集
programme.desc: 鳳凰聚焦: 關註重大時政選題, 重大社會事件和新聞熱點原創性挖掘更多事實與背景分析梳理新聞的前期後果, 人物命運, 呈現權威觀點

programme.title: 我們和牠們 第182集
programme.desc: 我們和牠們講述人與動物之間有趣真攀又感人的故事在這個治癒系節目中, 有各種各樣吸引人眼球的動物, 充滿真情流露的時刻, 也傳遞了人與動物自然和諧相處的價值理念, 展示了保護動物的積極態度人們的善良可親, 動物們的活潑可愛, 共同構築了一個個生動又溫馨的場景節目以紀實拍攝的手法, 從人與動物自然和諧相處的角度, 講述跨物種的感人故事, 傳遞純潔善良的高尚情操

programme.title: 鳳凰全球連線
programme.desc: 鳳凰全球連線為你帶來世界各地的熱點新聞, 並深入探討事件始末因由, 分析事情的重要性主持人會於直播時段, 通過衛星電話與全球各地的鳳凰衛視記者特約記者評論員連線, 向你匯報當天要聞

programme.title: 有報天天讀
programme.desc: 有報天天讀搜羅全球主流的媒體和重要報紙雜誌的最新資訊和精華焦點, 內容充實, 資訊豐富, 節奏明快, 充滿動感和創意, 是個既有個性, 也有獨到見解的節目

programme.title: 鳳凰衝擊播 第704集
programme.desc: 時事亮亮點: 文史哲學養深厚的學人何亮亮主持時事亮亮點, 盤點上週重要而值得關注的新聞熱點, 展開深入分析, 通過夾播夾議, 點出事件的癥結及延續的影響

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 第1596集
programme.desc: 紀錄．大時代: 紀錄珍貴片段, 重溫精彩大時代, 紀錄．大時代為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片, 把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前

programme.title: 總編輯時間

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Audrey reprimands DeVere for not fulfilling his duties as lord of the manor when he fails to attend church on Sunday, but then forgets to practice what she preaches. Penelope Keith and Peter Bowles star

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Richard has an accident and Hyacinth decides to buy a small country retreat - but her plans go awry in a most unexpected fashion. Comedy, starring Patricia Routledge and Clive Swift

programme.title: Rise of the Clans
programme.desc: Neil Oliver examines the history of the nations ancient clans, beginning with those who rallied behind Robert the Bruce in his against-all-odds bid to win Scotlands crown. After their crucial role in beating the English at Bannockburn in 1314, Bruce rewarded the loyal chiefs with land and titles

programme.title: Britain in Focus: A Photographic History
programme.desc: Eamonn McCabe explores the development of the art of photography in the UK, beginning by looking at how science and technology allowed pioneering photographers like Roger Fenton and Julia Margaret Cameron to create a new art form in the 1800s

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Plants
programme.desc: The first in a two-part documentary exploring the world of plants and their vital role on Earth. This edition takes a look at studies that have uncovered how plants are able to smell, touch and taste, offering viewers a fresh perspective on the greenery they share the planet with

programme.title: Deep, Down and Dirty: The Science of Soil
programme.desc: Gardening expert Chris Beardshaw explores where soil comes from, and what it is made of. It is an often misunderstood substance, with people sometimes dismissing it as dirt, so he reveals it as it has never been seen before using specialist microphotography, and highlights what makes it so essential to life. Research shows that humans are pushing this precious resource to its limit, and scientists are battling to find ways of preserving it for the future

programme.title: Britain in Focus: A Photographic History
programme.desc: Eamonn McCabe explores the development of the art of photography in the UK, beginning by looking at how science and technology allowed pioneering photographers like Roger Fenton and Julia Margaret Cameron to create a new art form in the 1800s

programme.title: The Flying Gardener
programme.desc: Chris Beardshaw visits Sussex to view the arboretums at Leonardslee Garden and Sheffield Park Garden to discover how trees of all sizes can be used to create stunning vistas

programme.title: Rise of the Clans
programme.desc: Neil Oliver examines the history of the nations ancient clans, beginning with those who rallied behind Robert the Bruce in his against-all-odds bid to win Scotlands crown. After their crucial role in beating the English at Bannockburn in 1314, Bruce rewarded the loyal chiefs with land and titles

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson makes an amazing discovery at Norfolks impressive Holkham Estate - its lost medieval village, seen for the first time since its disappearance some 200 years ago. The current village was once owned by Thomas William Coke, known as Coke of Norfolk, he is known as one of the great farming reformers of his time, instrumental in the agricultural revolution. Ben explores its oldest building, The Ancient House, as well as Holkhams beautiful stately home

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming tackles the fast-flowing River Trent and is invited to join a night-time illuminated boat parade. However, his journey is hampered by a damaged wall in Worksop and a water shortage on the Chesterfield Canal which threatens his voyage

programme.title: The Bridge: Fifty Years Across the Forth
programme.desc: Documentary celebrating the Forth Road Bridge, one of Scotlands great landmarks and the biggest of its kind when it opened in 1964. The film includes the recollections of those who built the bridge, the memories of former ferry workers and old home-movie footage

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: Two tough New York cops use unorthodox methods to try to break an international drug ring. When their information leads them to place a candy store under surveillance, they discover the owners are the American agents for a French kingpin planning to ship millions of dollars worth of heroin into the US. Oscar-winning fact-based thriller, starring Gene Hackman, Roy Scheider, Fernando Rey and Tony Lo Bianco

programme.title: The Poughkeepsie Shuffle: Tracing The French Connection
programme.desc: Critic Mark Kermode examines the making of classic thriller The French Connection, beginning with the history behind the 1960s drug bust that inspired the film. Featuring contributions from William Friedkin, stars Gene Hackman and Roy Scheider, and former New York police officer Sonny Grosso. First broadcast 15 January 2000

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Gaelic rapper Hammy Sgth and learner Liam McCormick join Joy in the studio, while Calum Maclean takes to the wing in Glasgow, trying out a pastime in which many Scots participate

programme.title: An L News
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA

programme.title: Lios Mhiri
programme.desc: Visual artist and horticulturalist Miri Gillies has made some changes in the garden, introducing her new indoor growing space. She visits island gardener Murdo Macdonald, who has created a beautiful and productive garden from scratch, and former colleague Louise Galloway, who gives her a tour of the research glasshouses at the Royal Botanic Garden in Edinburgh

programme.title: Hebridean Baker - Nordic Islands
programme.desc: Situated north of the Arctic Circle, the Lofoten Islands in Norway are famed for their dramatic mountain landscapes and cod fisheries. Coinneach arrives MacLeod in March during peak cod season, helping to unload the days catch and observing the stockfish drying process. He works with a local chef to create a fine-dining dish using the wind-dried cod, makes lefse, a traditional flatbread, and harvests seaweed. A dinner of Lofotlam, a globally protected local lamb, rounds off his visit

programme.title: Rrachd Foraging
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke explore plants that thrive at the edge of nature, from shoreline saltmarsh to city centre, sand dune to wild garden corner. Lucy visits a favourite east coast location to show Mary Ann Seabuckthorn what grows in shoreline dunes, where different enterprising companies make the most of the fruit. Plus, the pair spend time in Edinburghs Royal Botanic Garden

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate MacLeod, aka The Hebridean Mermaid, explores the hidden gems of the Hebrides, meeting tradition bearers with remarkable stories about the places she loves to visit the most, above and below the water. In this episode she comes across an interesting sea creature, known as a sunfish, which is native to tropical waters, but is likely to have been carried to the islands by the Gulf Stream. Swimming on its side, the sun heats its body and it feeds on jellyfish. She also journeys to Taransay, home of some of the most stunning and unique beaches in the Outer Hebrides. Once a thriving community, the island had three villages, but is now home to deer, seabirds and cattle.

programme.title: Faodail: Found
programme.desc: The Faodail Film Archive, which gathers lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, storing the footage for future generations. The Cinema Sgre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gidhealtachd for contemporary audiences

programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon enjoys a two-day getaway in Aberdeenshire. Arriving in Newburgh, he heads straight for the beach with its vast pink strand and towering dunes. He spots Eider ducks and learns about the seal colony that now call the beach home. Before long hes in the sea himself getting a windsurfing lesson. Travelling inland, he learns how to make truffles from a local chocolatier in Ellon and makes his way to Slains Castle at Cruden Bay. programme.title: Murder Trial: Death of a Dog Walker
programme.desc: Part two of two. With Brian Lows family desperately seeking justice and answers, the fate of ex-gamekeeper David Campbell hangs in the balance. The court is shown dramatic footage from Campbells custody interview where tempers flared when allegations were put to him, with the prosecution pointing to a guilty man on the ropes, while the defence argue it shows a police force under pressure to get their man

programme.title: Live Tennis
programme.desc: The Cincinnati Open. Coverage of day six of the joint ATP 1000 and WTA 1000 event, a hard-court tournament at Lindner Family Tennis Center in Mason, Ohio, where the third round is scheduled to conclude. Alexei Popyrin and Andrey Rublev were involved in the match of the round in last years mens draw, which saw the latter come out on top via a 6-7 7-6 7-5 score. The number two seed Carlos Alcaraz had an easier time of things as he triumphed 6-4 6-4 against Hamad Medjedovic to book his place in the last-16

programme.title: Live Tennis
programme.desc: The Cincinnati Open. Further coverage of day six of the joint ATP 1000 and WTA 1000 event, a hard-court tournament at Lindner Family Tennis Center in Mason, Ohio. Magda Linette claimed a surprise 7-6 3-6 6-3 win over the number four seed Jessica Pegula at the corresponding stage 12 months ago, while the second seed Coco Gauff benefited from a walkover victory when Dayana Yastremska had to withdraw from their match without taking to the court

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Australia is one of the most diverse countries on earth with over 80percent of its animals found nowhere else in the world. This series explores wildlifes unique traits revealing the creative, aggressive, social and curious.

programme.title: The World
programme.desc: Theres never been a more important time to stay in touch with whats happening in our world. Girish Sawlani presents the latest international news from ABC News correspondents as well as interviews with experts and guests.

programme.title: News Breakfast
programme.desc: News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport and weather from Australias most trusted source. Dont just start your day informed, start your day in front.

programme.title: News Breakfast
programme.desc: As each day begins get the facts you need to stay informed. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato present the latest news, overnight developments and todays top stories, joined by Catherine Murphy, Nate Byrne and Lillian Rangiah.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings
programme.desc: Stay in the know with whats going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the days top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Landline
programme.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: The multi-award winning Four Corners returns for another year of powerhouse investigative journalism - fearless and forensic, exposing scandals, triggering inquiries, leading debate and holding power to account for 65 years.

programme.title: Media Watch
programme.desc: Australias leading forum for media analysis and comment. Walkley award-winning investigative reporter and former foreign correspondent Linton Besser brings you a fearless critique of the weeks journalism.

programme.title: Finding Stars
programme.desc: A poetic documentary exploring our connection to the night sky, its ancient stories, modern mysteries, and unexplained lights told through a philosophical lens shaped by mortality and our place in the universe.

programme.title: Grand Designs Australia
programme.desc: A homeowner takes a tiny rundown heritage-listed workers cottage in the middle of the dense inner city Sydney suburb of Newtown and transforms it into a beautiful, fully sustainable off-grid home. Final

programme.title: Movin To The Country
programme.desc: Halina goes to Kangaroo Island to meet the owner of a wildlife sanctuary who rebounded from the 2020 bushfires, Kristy meets some footy legends in the Clare Valley and Craig is in the Barossa Valley, on a sheep farm. Final

programme.title: Great Australian Road Trips
programme.desc: Four high-profile Australian stars embark on an epic road trip across the countrys most iconic landscapes, one unforgettable pit-stop at a time. With Melissa Leong, Nazeem Hussain, Claudia Karvan and Steph Tisdell.

programme.title: ABC News with Joe OBrien
programme.desc: Joe OBrien brings you a comprehensive summary of the days events, with the latest breaking news, in depth coverage of the top stories, live crosses, interviews and explainers to bring you up to speed on whats going on.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Prepare to be heart-warmed, as Adam and guests, the heart of Gourmet Traveller, Joanna Hunkin, and the heart of Darjeeling Express, Asma Khan, make food with love and care.

programme.title: That Pacific Sports Show
programme.desc: Join Tiana Penitani Gray and Sam Wykes for your weekly hit of Pacific joy, as they share inspiring stories and incredible sporting prowess of athletes with Pacific Island heritage, from Australia and around the world.

The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 他从火光中走来Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 大泼猴The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 天地剑心Sword and Beloved
programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由同时王权富贵内心渴望自由憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. Trained as a Daoist soldier, Fu Gui lived a life without freedom. programme.title: 现在很美丽Its Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her fathers whereabouts

Winda promised to be responsible. What is the next story?

programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a simple yet happily married couple. Their happiness is tested when their child, Zahra, is diagnosed with a serious illness amidst their financial struggles. At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: 鬼才之道Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: 新晋女鬼同学必须在阴间证明自己的生存价值，因为每只鬼魂都必须有吓人业绩才能在鬼界生存无法吓人的鬼不仅拿不到猛鬼证，还可能会消失在阴间过气人气女鬼Catherine和她的经理人Makoto连手，想把同学训练成鬼界新星，让她施展最惊心动魄的吓人技俩

programme.title: 破地狱The Last Dance
programme.desc: 在疫情肆虐生意萧条的情况下，债台高筑的婚礼策划师道生转型为葬礼经纪人，寻求新的出路凭借创新且独特的经营策略，道生意外获得成功；在德高望重的喃呒师傅文哥的启发下，他的职业观与人生态度随之逐渐蜕变

programme.title: 峰爆Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: 一座修建十年的隧道即将竣工之际，受地震引发连串的地裂和山泥倾泻所影响，隧道与附近的县城危在旦夕一位退休军人和儿子俩，于绝境挺身而出，积极救援为了守护县城16万人的安危，基建的代表人会否炸毁承载了十年心血的隧道呢?

programme.title: 家有囍事2009Alls Well Ends Well 2009
programme.desc: 女强人余珠性格暴躁，一直单身她的弟弟余宝因家中有长女未嫁，弟妹不得嫁娶，否则多灾多难的严格家规，感到十分苦恼为了打破这个困局，余宝聘请了专门解决爱情问题的爱情治疗师曹迪克，向余珠展开热烈追求余珠随即对曹迪克一见钟情，决心让他永远留在自己身边

programme.title: 长空之王Born to Fly
programme.desc: 经过严苛的选拔，雷宇正式成为中国的新一代试飞员在队长张挺带领下，雷宇等优秀飞行员奉命为最新型的战机试飞在高空上，雷宇不断挑战自我极限，一次又一次的试飞，只希望试出最好的战机，让飞行战斗员安全回家

programme.title: 旺角监狱To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: 辉张家辉 饰 是仁义社的杀手，旺角是仁义社的地盘为尽江湖手足情，辉便代替兄弟箭猪韦家雄 饰去斩杀廿多名黑道中人当年往逮捕细辉的探员枪王余 廖启智 饰碰到他，吓得屁滚尿流，连警枪都跌了本来，辉要置他于死地，但讲道义的细辉，见枪王余这样可怜，放他一马，却反被枪王余在他背后轰了一枪，不单受伤，还被拘捕下狱三十年可是，辉亦因此成为仁义社的英雄，旺角的传奇！出狱后，辉已和社会脱节，回到面目全非的旺角，差点连回家也不懂受精神分裂症影响，他以为永远也逃不出旺角，就像置身于监狱一样在旺角的黑道上，他出手救了来自内地的一对姊妹，其中妹妹是弱智的，却惹来不少麻烦 好不容易回到旺角老家，发现已年迈母亲患上老人痴呆症，连自己儿子也认不到...有一天，辉母突然清醒与辉相认，却于同一天逝世 辉为营救这对落难姊妹，招来了杀身之祸，黑白两道狂追猛打...

programme.title: 不日成婚 2Ready OR Rot
programme.desc: 阿佳和可怡二人终于要结婚，却遇到佳母施加压力，令二人产生种种摩擦另一边，灰熊又怀疑妻子红杏出墙而当阿健的女友 Jessica意外怀孕时，他陷入人生最迷茫而不知应该如何做决定的时候众人最后可否化解他们感情上的冲突？

programme.title: 第一炉香Love After Love
programme.desc: 电影由许鞍华导演，改编自张爱玲的首部短篇小说三十年代，年青女学生葛薇龙离乡别背井从上海到香港求学，因生活拮据，求助姑妈代交学费，却被姑妈利用，成为上流社会社交游戏的诱饵当她爱上花花公子乔琪乔时，正是她堕落的开始

programme.title: OMG! 阿妈有喜OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53岁的Rita和丈夫计划退休，却意外怀孕，打乱了原本平静的家庭生活面对这突如其来的新生命，一场安胎之战带来连串笑料与混乱，让一家人重拾理解与包容正当一切看似平静，Rita得知胎儿疑似患有唐氏综合症，她将面临人生最艰难抉择

programme.title: 海关战线Customs Frontline

programme.desc: Ramli akhirnya membuka mulut siapa dirinya, juga mengenai Wan Peah. Susulan itu, Tok Hashim dan Farhan pergi menziarahi Ramli dan terbongkarlah kisah lama mereka. Cikgu Zaiton masih tak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti, dia datang serang rumah Cikgu Siti dan tiba-tiba Wan Peah muncul.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP5
programme.desc: Zacky terkesan dengan kematian adiknya Aeera. Dia menyalahkan Ritz dan Affiyah atas apa yang berlaku. Tindakan Rafeeq cuba membunuh Affiyah tergendala dengan kemunculan seorang jururawat. Affiyah yang terlantar dihospital akhirnya meninggal setelah diganggu dengan mimpi ngeri serta mimpi bertemu arwah ibunya.Ritz bersedih atas pemergian adiknya dan Zacky pula terbaring tidak sedarkan diri menerima berita tentang Affiyah. Rafeeq mula terasa kesal atas perbuatannya terhadap Affiyah selama ini

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP15
programme.desc: Kerja vigilante McCall merumitkan lagi kehidupan peribadinya apabila dia terpaksa meminta bantuan bekas suaminya, Dr. Miles Fulton, untuk membantu mangsa tembakan, salah seorang daripada dua wanita yang diburu pencuri selepas mereka menyaksikan rompakan.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: Hantu Baru
programme.desc: Sasa mati dalam kemalangan tanpa menyedari kematiannya. Dua roh membantunya memahami keadaan dan menyelamatkan adik-beradiknya supaya dia dapat pergi dengan tenang.

programme.desc: Topik yang akan dibincangkan dalam episod kali ini ialah Pahala Memuliakan Anak Yatim. Bersama dengan Prof Madya Dato Dr. Izhar Ariff dan panel jemputan yang akan menghuraikan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut.

programme.title: Perempuan Tepi Jalan
programme.desc: Insiden di pasaraya membuatkan Maya mula takut untuk keluar rumah. Manakala Aira pula mengadu telah didatangi seorang lelaki yang tak dikenali, mengaku sebagai kawan Maya. Ketegangan Maya membuatkan Ferdaus dan Umi tertanya-tanya. Namun Maya masih belum memiliki kekuatan untuk berterus terang tentang keadaan sebenarnya. Ferdaus kata dia mahu menjemput tetamu datang makan malam, Maya segera menggalakkan dengan menawarkan resepi yang enak-enak untuk disajikan. Alangkah terkejutnya Maya apabila tamu yang dijemput oleh Ferdaus adalah Datuk Rizlan!

programme.title: Sunnah Nabi
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Ustaz Tajid membawa topik Ekonomi Muamalat Hutang dengan panel Ustaz Hassan Adli. Sunnah Nabi merupakan program keagamaan yang membawakan perbincangan santai namun ilmiah mengenai amalan sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian umat Islam. Program ini menampilkan pelbagai topik umum dan khusus berkaitan sunnah.

programme.title: Cuba Teka
programme.desc: Episod kali ini membawakan Penceramah Agama. Rancangan berkonsepkan program realiti game show secara santai dan terbuka bersama pengacara anda Sissy Iman dan Marc Syahmie dan 3 orang peserta setiap episod yang terdiri daripada selebriti dan instafemes, youtuber, wartawan dan institusi-institusi.

programme.title: Ustaz Adik Cik
programme.desc: Elisa yang perlu menjaga dua anak saudaranya, Arif, 16 thn, dan Afik, 8 thn, ketika ibu bapa mereka pergi ke Mekah untuk tunaikan haji. Elisa yang selama ini berlagak baik di hadapan keluarga tapi sebenarnya seorang yang gemar bersosial, terpaksa menyesuaikan diri ketika menjaga Arif dan Afik. Sikap Arif yang suka bermain dan malas belajar, membuatkan Arif lebih rapat dan suka pada Elisa. Tetapi lain pula Afik yang lebih alim dan baik, sering persoalkan tindakan Elisa yang suka benarkan Arif bawa kawan-kawan datang ke rumah bermain sehingga abaikan solat dan kerja sekolah. Berbuih mulut Afik menasihati Arif dan Elisa tetapi mereka degil dan tetap malas hendak solat. Kerana tidak tahan melihat kemungkaran yang berlaku dalam rumah, Afik keluar untuk tenangkan jiwanya di masjid. Tetapi ketika itulah dia diculik oleh sekumpulan penjenayah dan ini membuat Arif dan Elisa rasa amat bersalah.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. programme.title: Seribu Nina

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih 2
programme.desc: Lanjutan dari Ketika Cinta Bertasbih yang mengisahkan Azzam kembali ke Indonesia selepas 9 tahun belajar di Kairo. Walaupun sudah bergelar sarjana, dia sukar cari kerja dan dipengaruhi tekanan masyarakat. Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

programme.title: Air Mata Terakhir Bunda
programme.desc: Seorang ibu berkorban demi anak-anaknya walaupun terpaksa menghadapi penderitaan dan perpisahan yang menyayat hati.

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Kisah pasangan warga emas, Jaap dan Maartje, yang mengembara ke Sepanyol untuk bertemu sahabat lama. Perjalanan tersebut membuka kembali kenangan lama serta membantu mereka menemukan semula makna cinta dan hubungan mereka selepas bertahun bersama.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Zharfa
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cewe
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.desc: Konsert kolaborasi istimewa antara kumpulan Ungu dan finalis DAcademy 7. Menampilkan gabungan muzik pop dan dangdut menerusi lagu-lagu popular Ungu yang diberi sentuhan dangdut bersama finalis DAcademy 7.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the Critical Care Unit, searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Ready OR Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chuns surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Song Of Spring
programme.desc: An 85-year-old mother lives with her 65-year-old daughter who is suffering from Alzheimers disease, causing her to suffer a decline in memory, mental confusion and disorientation. Though the elderly mother has to shoulder the burden of a caregiver, she still wants to be with her daughter forever.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Cat vs Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.desc: 節目深度探訪在地各個層面世代與角落中有故事的人，透過來賓分享自身豐富的人生閱歷與生命體悟，傳遞社會上的真善美，引領觀眾透過一段段動人的經歷更加認識自己

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第325集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目藝次元宇宙，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事

programme.title: 2024當代生活講座第13集
programme.desc: 2024當代生活講座

programme.title: 生活智多星第1813集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 手術直播間第9集

programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 映照人生第516集

programme.title: 大自然生趣第33集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 繪聲繪影第23集

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第231集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於客家觀點的重要新聞議題呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現

programme.title: 大自然生趣第34集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道南路鷹一萬死九千這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，大自然生趣 大自然生趣，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味很湊巧的，生趣這兩個字，其實這是客語有趣的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是大自然真有趣這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 我的男友是媽寶第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 本季媽寶們強勢回歸，麥特跟金姆的婚禮策劃與新屋工程都因為新冠肺炎疫情而停擺，凱莉又不斷想主導新屋規劃方面的決策，讓金姆感到頭疼沙奇伯與艾蜜莉分手半年後復合，兩人把這消息告訴萊拉，沒想到卻得到意外的回應布萊恩與翠絲交往十年終於要步入婚姻，但這位媽寶新郎竟邀請媽媽潔恩一起去蜜月旅行，翠絲聽聞後傻眼不已

programme.title: 無窮潛力第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡，潔絲敏幫助洛杉磯的消防員艾倫與他太太達琳改造他們的房屋，這間房子位於絕佳的地段與住宅區，卻完全沒有反映出他們一家喜愛的海灘風格潔絲敏改造露臺，讓一家人能在屋外野餐放鬆，室內方面則打通了兩間起居室，拆掉廚房裡的柱子，為廚房設計超大中島，此外她還訂製了一張原木餐桌，加入宛若河川的桌面設計，整體前後呼應的全新海灘屋令這對夫妻驚呼連連

programme.title: 無窮潛力第2季:第14集
programme.desc: 本集的委託人喜歡提基風格，然而屋外的大片植物遮蔽自然光線，造成屋內陰暗，而且動線不佳，在潔絲敏的巧手下，結合屋主喜歡的提基風格與家的感覺，呈現溫馨又有特色的設計，讓屋主們大為讚嘆

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.title: 房產兄弟-A咖報恩計畫第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集節目中克莉絲珍娜帶著女兒金卡黛珊以及坎達爾珍娜去隱山市向她認識多年的好友麗莎報恩去年麗莎的丈夫和母親雙雙過世，她度過一段很難熬的時期，回來隱山市買了新房子，翻修好室內後已無力繼續改造院子她們請來史考特兄弟協助，過程中珍娜及卡黛珊家族也提供了許多設計點子，甚至親自動手參與翻修,要為她打造出完美的院子，實現她的夢想

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第20季:第8集

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.title: 我的男友是媽寶第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 習歐斯的媽媽因為術後行動不便，樣樣事情都找兒子幫忙，兩人出門後還搞失蹤不接電話，這讓女友蒂雅心生不滿史黛芬妮回老家找爸媽討論跟麥克最近的感情問題，家人皆鼓勵她跟他坦承自己的心情布萊恩成功說服翠絲帶潔恩一起去蜜月旅行，不過翠絲的姊姊認為這種事情不趕緊解決未來只會一再發生凱莉高興地拿出自己的舊婚紗跟金姆討論婚禮策劃；金姆終於向麥特坦白工作機會的事，卻得到意外的回應
